summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting the termination of a $7.5 million senior secured revolving credit facility with Banc of California, originally dated September 9, 2019. The facility had been used for general corporate and investment purposes; as of June 29, 2026, no borrowings were outstanding. The company voluntarily terminated the facility in light of limited usage and annual commitment fees, incurring no material early termination penalties. The custodian agreement with U.S. Bank was also terminated. This is a routine decommissioning of an undrawn credit line, not a special situation event.
